name: Puntonet Epicentro Quito data center
notes: New northern Quito facility reported as about 8,000 sqm, 6 MW, 250 racks in first phase scaling to 1,008 racks, with investment up to USD 100 million; source says it will be Puntonet's seventh Ecuador data center.

name: Telconet planned Quito data center (eighth facility)
notes: Telconet disclosed a further Quito data center targeted for commissioning in Q3 2028; no site-specific MW found in public reporting.

name: Cirion Quito Data Center (QUI2 / Carcelen)
notes: Official Cirion page lists the QUI2 carrier-neutral data center in Quito; Cirion press release says the Carcelen, Ecuador facility received Uptime Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: Telconet Cloud Center II Quito
notes: Uptime Institute project page identifies Telconet Cloud Center II in Quito, Ecuador; PRNewswire/IDC-G described Telconet as operating carrier-neutral Quito and Guayaquil data centers.

name: Centro de Datos CNT EP - Quito
developer: Corporacion Nacional de Telecomunicaciones CNT E.P.
notes: Uptime Institute lists Centro de Datos CNT EP - Quito in Quito Pichincha with Tier III design/constructed facility awards; DCD reported inauguration of the Quito data center with investment above USD 21 million.

name: Cloudflare Quito edge data center
notes: Cloudflare announced a Quito, Ecuador data center deployment in partnership with the NAP.EC Internet exchange run by AEPROVI.

name: EdgeUno Quito / UIO data center
notes: EdgeUno location page lists UIO - Quito, Ecuador; EdgeUno Ecuador page says it provides equipment accommodation in first-level data centers in Quito and Guayaquil. Datacenters.com identifies an EdgeUno UIO2 Quito facility in Carcelen, Pichincha.

name: Transnexa Ecuador Quito data center
notes: Inflect lists a Transnexa Ecuador data center in Quito and separately includes Transnexa Ecuador Quito among Quito data center locations; no primary operator page or MW found.

name: Conecel Data Xperience Center Collaloma
notes: Uptime Institute Ecuador awards list includes Conecel S.A. Data Xperience Center Collaloma in Quito, Ecuador, with Tier III constructed-facility certification for Nivel 2 and design certification for additional rooms.

name: Telxius Cable TSAL01 Salinas data center
notes: Datacenters.com and Inflect list TSAL01 Salinas / Telxius Cable in Santa Elena, Ecuador. Telxius official pages describe its data centers and 26 cable landing stations/data centers, but the public page found did not expose TSAL01-specific MW.
